blocks.text: What sold in South Surrey and White Rock

In the second quarter of 2026, 53 commercial properties sold in the City of Surrey as a whole (against 44 a year earlier), worth $249.9M in all: 19 industrial, 15 land, 7 office, 12 retail and other, and 0 multi-family. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so these figures include South Surrey, Cloverdale, Newton, Guildford and Whalley. White Rock, reported separately, had 3 sales worth $4.6M.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Industrial space in South Surrey and White Rock

Industrial space in the Surrey submarket (45.1M sq ft) was 4.2% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $19.66 per sq ft net plus $6.95 in additional rent, with 1,628,917 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey and White Rock commercial and industrial zones

Zoning decides what a commercial property can be used for. These are the City of Surrey and White Rock zones on the zoning guide (they apply across the whole municipality, not only South Surrey and White Rock); each links to its permitted uses, smallest new lot and height limits.
